outcome: Obstetric comorbid conditions (Pre-eclampsia, previous cesarean delivery, arterial hypertension)
cohort: The study included 1,995,953 deliveries recorded in Spain between 2016 and 2022, categorized by maternal diabetes status (T1DM, T2DM, GDM, or no diabetes).
finding: Women with T1DM, T2DM, and GDM experienced higher rates of obstetric comorbidities, cesarean delivery, and severe maternal morbidity compared to women without diabetes, with the incidence of T1DM and GDM increasing over time while T2DM remained stable.
mod_finding: Women with T1DM, T2DM, and GDM had significantly higher probabilities of cesarean delivery (2.38, 1.79, and 1.19 times greater, respectively) compared to women who did not have diabetes.
